create.name: Saeeda Hafiz
create.bio:
Saeeda Hafiz is a yoga teacher and writer in the San Francisco Bay Area whose teaching joins a steady asana practice with simple, plant-based cooking. She began practising yoga in January 1990 and trained with the Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centers, and later studied cookery at the Natural Gourmet Institute, after earlier graduating from Temple University. For more than twenty-five years she has taught yoga and whole-food cooking, including as a health educator with San Francisco's public schools.

In San Francisco she has taught hatha, restorative and yin classes at community studios and YMCAs, occasional yin-and-tea pop-up evenings, and private one-to-one sessions sold singly or in packs. Her memoir, The Healing: One Woman's Journey from Poverty to Inner Riches, tells how yoga and a change in the way she ate reshaped her life, and she has spoken about it with the Black Yoga Teachers Alliance and on radio and panels. Her site also offers a short guided meditation free to anyone who wants to try sitting with her voice, along with sample chapters and recipes.
